page.title: AI Setting
page.subtitle: Configure an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint used for NL-to-SQL and AI summaries.

form.noSavedSettings: No saved settings yet — they appear after you click Save
form.baseUrlHelper: Used exactly as entered — nothing is appended. Stored locally in %APPDATA%.
form.apiKeyHelperRestore: Cleared after the model change — the key saved for {{label}} is still on file.
form.apiKeyHelper: Optional — leave blank for keyless endpoints such as local Ollama.
form.modelHelper: Free text — type any model name, including models not listed in the presets.

alerts.disabled: AI is disabled — NL-to-SQL (“Ask AI”) and AI summaries are off until you enable it and save.

deleteDialog.title: Delete saved setting?
deleteDialog.body: will be removed from the "Saved settings" dropdown. Its API key stays on file, so re-saving the same endpoint configuration restores it.

messages.saved: AI settings saved — the assistant uses them on your next message.
